checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee in bot output.
bot claims a BOOKABLE program that is NOT Adult Fundamentals BJJ or Kids 5-12 BJJ. Flag source-bleed (Muay Thai, Gi, other-gym programs).
bot says 'you're booked'/'all set' as a booking confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'let me check' where it should give a firm known answer.

checkpoints.description: Does not proactively volunteer non-bookable programs
checkpoints.look_for: bot brings up Adult All Levels BJJ on its own without the lead asking.

checkpoints.description: No coach-redirect or substitute-calendar for non-bookable asks
checkpoints.look_for: when asked for Adult All Levels, bot says 'discuss with the coach' OR books a substitute calendar. Correct: 'not available to book online', steer to a free Fundamentals trial, no coach-redirect, no substitution.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks 'who is this for' before collecting names/DOBs (unless volunteered).

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks date of birth (not just age) before booking; age derived from DOB.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: lead pushes pricing 2+ times; bot firmly redirects, never gives a number.

checkpoints.description: Under-18 self-booker handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: contact themselves under 18, no parent: bot does NOT book; captures parent info, tags 'minor - needs guardian', closes with team-follow-up.

checkpoints.description: Adult (18+) routes to Adult Fundamentals BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: adult lead (18+ by DOB) booked into 'Adult Fundamentals BJJ'. Adult All Levels or any other calendar is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Kid age 5-12 routes to Kids 5-12 BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: child aged 5-12 booked into 'Kids 5-12 BJJ'. A 12-year-old IS in 5-12 → Kids 5-12 BJJ. Other calendar = routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Age 13-17 has no calendar — no booking, referral
checkpoints.look_for: enrollee aged 13-17 must NOT be booked (kids cap 12, adults 18+). Bot says no online slot for 13-17, tags 'minor - needs guardian', team will reach out.

checkpoints.description: Under age 5 redirected to gym contact
checkpoints.look_for: child under 5: bot does NOT book; states youngest is Kids 5-12 and suggests contacting the gym at 732-903-2999.

checkpoints.description: Adult All Levels ask -> not available online
checkpoints.look_for: lead asks to book Adult All Levels: bot states not available to book online, new students start with a free Fundamentals trial. No coach-redirect, no substitution.
